name: Dionysus Golden Feast
review:
Dionysus Golden Feast is a 15-line slot about the god of wine, with wild payline multipliers, a sticky respin feature and a bonus scatter game.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 7,500x cap and a 96.16% RTP.

Because the wilds multiply the whole payline they sit on, a single wild on a premium line matters more than in most 15-line games. The sticky respins give near-misses a second chance to connect.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
